title: Pelican Paradise Unit A | Scenic Stays
meta_description: The sun and the sea await at Pelican Paradise A, a distinguished beachfront retreat in Seacrest Beach along Scenic Highway 30A. This property
description_expanded: The sun and the sea await at Pelican Paradise A, a distinguished beachfront retreat in Seacrest Beach along Scenic Highway 30A. This property's location is unbeatable, near shopping, dining, and located directly on the Gulf of Mexico! Nestled in the private, gated community of Camp Creek Lake and with a private pool to boot, you’ll find everything you need and more for the perfect getaway! Please note, this listing is for Pelican Paradise A. This unique property can be booked with Pelican Paradise B as a combined private, 10-bedroom oasis. View the combined Pelican Paradise listing. Pelican Paradise A is a spacious refuge with five bedrooms and four and a half baths accommodating up to seventeen. Tastefully decorated and with beautiful interior finishes, rooms are bright and cheerful with plenty of space for everyone. The ground level, with three full bedrooms and a sleeper sofa, accommodates 11 guests comfortably. The first bedroom sleeps three and features a twin over full bunk bed, the second bedroom houses two twin bunk beds, and the last bedroom features a king-sized bed. You’ll also find a wet bar and wine cooler for quick access to cool refreshments. A deluxe, fully appointed kitchen awaits on the second floor with high-end appliances and plenty of cabinet space. The open-concept area includes a wraparound kitchen counter with bar stools, a beautiful dining table with seating for six, and newly upholstered sofas and chairs in the living room. Take in gorgeous views of the Gulf from the interior or out on the second-story balcony with a propane grill and outdoor seating, a lovely place to gather at day’s end! The third story houses the master bedroom with a king-sized bed and a gorgeous master bath with jetted garden tub. Enjoy leisurely mornings on the private balcony directly overlooking the Gulf of Mexico just outside your bedroom door! Lounge by the private pool or access the available beach gear set up and head over to the sandy shores for an evening stroll. Swing by The Hub, a central gathering spot in the nearby Watersound community, for great food, drinks, and live entertainment! Hop on the Timpoochee Trail and bike to the nearby communities of Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, or Inlet Beach for a day of fun in the sun! Requests for pool heating must be submitted a week prior to arrival and are subject to an additional $75 fee. Heating for pools is an additional $45 per day. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. *Notice- Neighbor has begun construction*
